name: set_update_policy
description: Set the update policy for a wiki page or folder — how Onyx auto-maintains it. Three independent settings, all inherited folder→page (a folder's policy applies to everything beneath it; a page or subfolder overrides its parent): (1) `ingestion_auto_update_disabled` — when true, connector/ingestion pushes will NOT rewrite this page (or anything under this folder); set false to (re-)enable. (2) `update_instruction` — free-text guidance the updater agent follows when it does edit this page/folder (e.g. "keep entries terse", "never touch the SLA table"); pass an empty string to clear it. (3) `ai_management_allowed` — when true, the AI may auto-manage this page/folder (apply organizational changes without per-change approval); when false, AI management is explicitly forbidden for this scope (also marks an intentional duplicate that must not be consolidated); omit/null inherits. PATCH semantics: only the settings you include change — omit a setting to leave it as-is. `path` is a page (ending in `.md`), a folder, or "" for the wiki root. Requires write permission on the path. Returns the resulting `explicit` policy set on this path and the `effective` policy after inheritance. ONLY call this when the user asks to change how a page/folder is auto-updated — never as a side effect of editing content.

path.description: Wiki-relative path: a page ending in `.md`, a folder, or "" for the wiki root. A page must already exist; a folder policy may be set ahead of its children (future pages inherit it).

ingestion_auto_update_disabled.description: true = block connector/ingestion auto-update for this page (or everything under this folder); false = allow it. Omit to leave unchanged.

update_instruction.description: Guidance the updater agent follows when editing this page/folder. Pass an empty string to clear it (so it inherits any ancestor instruction). Omit to leave unchanged.

ai_management_allowed.description: true = allow the AI to auto-manage this page (or everything under this folder) without per-change approval; false = explicitly forbid AI management for this scope (also serves as a do-not-consolidate marker). Omit to leave unchanged.
